about: Scalar operations, moved from the scalar_language module of scalar_language.rs at a47519f5d, whose tests saved output.csv and compared its bytes, or compared what a check and a refused build report. greatest and least skip missing operands, keep integers beyond 2^53 exact and keep dates as dates; a row template's str_template and greatest derive as a column derivation does; a Boolean literal in a row derivation converts to no column type, so it fails validation before any record is read (VALUE-24) and every save of that result fails, publishing nothing; an invalid regular expression in a str_extract over a CSV text column, or a group beyond its pattern's, is reported by the check and the refused build alike before the source is captured (TEXT-6, TEXT-10), whether or not the column is typed str; a str_extract over a non-text source fails first as incompatible_input_type (TEXT-1); and a decode, which reads a codelist the project file declares (EXPR-15), is refused as an unsupported operation by the check and the refused build alike, before any source is read, since this engine reads no project codelist for one (COLUMN-15). Each specification is its test's spec(derivation, type) template: the scalar document, with its RESULT column edited. The tests ran in a copy of adam-adae-text-cleanup whose spec.yaml and input.csv they replaced; their specifications read input.csv alone, so a case stages those two files, and no input.csv where its test removed it. A partial issue check keeps its compares. No engine output supplied these values.
